content.user_title: Deploy Kubernetes Workloads With Guided Steps
content.value_statement: Kubernetes releases require many coordinated artifacts and checks. This skill guides container preparation, manifests, Helm charts, service mesh, security, observability, and deployment validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides container image preparation, optimization, registry push, and container testing.
Outlines Kubernetes manifest creation for Deployment, Service, ConfigMap, Secret, and Ingress resources.
Includes Helm chart scaffolding steps for values, templates, dependencies, and chart testing.
Covers service mesh selection, traffic management, mTLS, and observability setup.
Provides quality gates for containers, manifests, Helm installation, security, monitoring, and deployment.
limitations: Provides workflow prompts and checklists, not executable deployment automation.
Depends on separately available referenced skills for specialized tasks.
Does not verify cluster state, credentials, registry access, or live rollout health.
Does not include environment-specific manifests, charts, or policy files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Kubernetes Release
use_cases.description: Create a phased release plan that covers containers, manifests, Helm packaging, security, monitoring, and rollout validation.

use_cases.title: Standardize Platform Deployment Steps
use_cases.description: Use the workflow phases as a repeatable checklist for teams deploying services to shared clusters.

use_cases.title: Review Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Check that deployment, service mesh, security, observability, and quality gates are addressed before production rollout.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Deployment
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a first Kubernetes deployment plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use kubernetes-deployment to create a phased deployment plan for my application. Include container preparation, manifests, Helm, security, monitoring, and rollout checks.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Release Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for operational release tracking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use kubernetes-deployment to turn my Kubernetes release into an ordered checklist. Highlight required inputs, owners, validation steps, and quality gates.

prompt_templates.title: Add Service Mesh and Observability
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for platform features around a workload rollout.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use kubernetes-deployment to extend my rollout plan with service mesh traffic management, mTLS, Prometheus monitoring, Grafana dashboards, alerts, and tracing.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Rollout Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for readiness and risk review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use kubernetes-deployment to review my production rollout strategy. Identify missing Kubernetes resources, security controls, observability checks, and GitOps deployment safeguards.

output_examples.input: Plan a Kubernetes deployment for a web API.
output: A phased plan covering image preparation, manifest creation, Helm packaging, service exposure, and deployment verification.
A readiness checklist for secrets, RBAC, NetworkPolicy, monitoring, alerts, and rollout health.

output_examples.input: Prepare Helm and service mesh work for a production cluster.
output: A Helm-focused task list for chart structure, values, templates, dependencies, and chart testing.
A service mesh checklist for traffic routing, mTLS, observability, and mesh selection.

output_examples.input: Review whether a deployment is ready for production.
output: A quality gate review covering containers, manifests, Helm installation, security controls, monitoring, and deployment success.
A list of follow-up checks that need cluster-specific evidence before rollout.

best_practices: Confirm referenced skills and cluster tools are available before following the workflow.
Treat secrets, RBAC, NetworkPolicy, and mTLS as required release gates.
Run each quality gate before moving from staging to production rollout.
anti_patterns: Skipping manifest validation because a Helm chart exists.
Deploying service mesh settings without clear mTLS and observability requirements.
Pushing images to a registry before scanning, testing, and tagging them consistently.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy directly to a Kubernetes cluster?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and prompts, but it does not execute kubectl, Helm, or CI commands.

faq.question: Can it help create Kubernetes manifests?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs manifest work for Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Ingress resources.

faq.question: Does it include Helm chart planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers chart structure, values, templates, dependencies, and chart testing steps.

faq.question: Does it cover service mesh setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes service mesh selection, traffic management, mTLS, and observability tasks.

faq.question: What should users verify before production rollout?
faq.answer: Users should verify containers, manifests, Helm installation, security controls, monitoring, and deployment success.

faq.question: Is this skill suitable for regulated environments?
faq.answer: It can support planning, but teams must add their own compliance controls, approvals, and environment-specific policies.
